### FileToolName

```ts
type FileToolName = "read" | "list" | "glob" | "grep" | "apply_patch";
```

Closed set of direct, model-visible Files tools; changing it is an ADR.

---

### FileTool

```ts
type FileTool = LabelledTool &
  Readonly<{
    [fileToolBrand]: true;
  }> &
  Readonly<{
    descriptor: Readonly<{
      name: FileToolName;
    }>;
    module: "files";
    access: Access;
  }>;
```

A `MuleTool` minted only by this module, named from the closed `FileToolName`
set. No host can construct one: the brand has no public constructor, so a
host-made `MuleTool` fails typecheck against `files?`.

### UiConnection

```ts
type UiConnection = Readonly<{
  source: CapabilitySource;
  fetch: (request) => Promise<Response>;
  close: () => Promise<void>;
}>;
```

Live commands of the App open in each Agent Session's browser. The Agent reaches
them through the `ui` module (`ui.discover`, `ui.execute`); the browser runs
them through Whistle over the transport this connection serves.

### edit()

```ts
function edit(
  port,
  input,
  context,
): Promise<
  | {
      path: string;
      bytes: number;
      diff: string;
      firstChangedLine: number | null;
      unifiedPatch: string | null;
      unifiedPatchBytes: number;
      unifiedPatchAddedLines: number;
      unifiedPatchRemovedLines: number;
      unifiedPatchTruncated: boolean;
    }
  | {
      status: "failed";
      error: {
        kind:
          | "not-found"
          | "ambiguous"
          | "file-too-large"
          | "partial-character"
          | "unchanged"
          | "not-text"
          | "conflict";
        path: string;
        message: string;
      };
    }
>;
```

### presentReadForGuest()

```ts
function presentReadForGuest(
  result,
  context,
):
  | {
      path: string;
      content: string;
      offset: number;
      nextOffset: number | null;
      truncated: boolean;
      file?: {
        computerId: string;
        path: string;
      };
    }
  | {
      path: string;
      image: {
        ref: string;
        mimeType: "image/png" | "image/jpeg" | "image/gif" | "image/webp";
        bytes: number;
      };
    };
```

Guest code and MCP callers never receive base64: the image goes through the
execution's image collector (the `images.view` path) and the value is a caption.
